data.name: Daghfal
data.gender_notes: Daghfal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'd-gh-l', meaning to cling or hold on firmly. This name signifies someone who is steadfast and unwavering in their beliefs and actions. The name Daghfal carries the meaning “He who is steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daghfal usually hope their child will grow to embody he who is steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes firmness in faith and steadfastness in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Daghfal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “He who is steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daghfal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: دغفَل
in_arabic.meaning: الغفلة، الذاكرة القوية، الحفاظ على الحقيقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم دغفَل متأصل من الجذر (د-غ-ف)، ويتصف بالغفلة والذاكرة القوية والحفاظ على الحقيقة. وتشير إلى الحفظ والذاكرة الحسنة، كما هو موضح في سورة البقرة. ويرمز إلى الحفاظ على الصدق والوحي، وهو اسم ذو أهمية دينية في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: دغفال
in_urdu.meaning: غفلت، ذاکرہ قوی، حقیقت کا محافظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام دغفال کا تعلق جڑ د-غ-ف سے ہے، اور اس کا مطلب غفلت، ذاکرہ قوی اور حقیقت کا محافظ ہے۔ یہ اسم ذاکرہ اور حفظ کا بھی علامت ہے، جیسا کہ سورة البقره میں دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ دغفال نام کا اسلامی روایات میں اہمیت ہے.

in_hindi.name: दघफल
in_hindi.meaning: गफलता, अच्छी याददाश्त, सत्य की रक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम दघफल का अर्थ गफलता, अच्छी याददाश्त और सत्य की रक्षा है। यह नाम ध्यान और याददाश्त की गहराई का प्रतीक है। इस नाम का इस्लामिक परंपराओं में महत्व है और इसे अच्छी याददाश्त और सच्चाई के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: دګفَل
in_pashto.long_meaning: دګفَل نوم دا ټکیب د غفلت، يادگيرۍ او حقيقت د رازناکو څخه دی، او دغه نوم دا د ياد له په ټولنه کې مهموالی لري، او دغه د ياد له په ټولنه کې د دغې نوم پر اهميت کول کېدای شي.

in_english.name: Daghfal
in_english.meaning: forgetfulness, strong memory, preservation of truth
in_english.long_meaning: The name Daghfal originates from the Arabic root (d-g-f), meaning forgetfulness, strong memory, and preservation of truth. It symbolizes retention and strong memory, as mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah. Daghfal is an important name in Islamic tradition, representing preservation of truth and sincerity.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'The Muqaddimah' (1377 AD) mentions Daghfal as a city in the Maghreb, situated between Tangier and Oran. It was a center of Berber power and resistance against Arab rule during the early Islamic period.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's 'Rihla' (1355 AD) describes Daghfal as a fortified town in the Maghreb, famous for its producers of leather, salt, and honey. It was a significant stop for merchants traveling between the Mediterranean coast and the Sahara.
historical_references.context: Important trade center in the Maghreb
